sentences.text:
Sexual Offences Act vs In Re : Shreyoshi Chatterjee @ Banti ...
on 3 February, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
03.02.2026 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No. M/L.120 Criminal
Miscellaneous Jurisdiction Ct.No.35 dc.

Rejected C.R.M. (M) 2066 of 2025 In Re : An Application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 read with Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with Berhampore Police Station Case No. 1624 of 2022 dated 04.12.2022 under Sections 370/376/372/373/120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4/5/7 of the Immoral Traffic Prevention Act and under Sections 4/8/12/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 And In Re : Shreyoshi Chatterjee @ Banti Chatterjee ... Petitioner.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Jisan Iqubal Hossain ... For the Petitioner.
Mr. Bitasok Banerjee, Ms. Sima Biswas ... For the State.
Status report and the report relating to service submitted by the learned advocate appearing for the State be kept with the record.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for 4 years 1 month and till date, trial has not been concluded.
Learned advocate appearing for the State, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for bail and submits that only two investigating officers are to be examined by the Trial Court.
Having considered the period of detention, learned Trial Court is directed to expedite the process so that evidence of the prosecution witnesses are closed within a period of sixty days.
Having regard to the final stages of the case before the learned Trial Court, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
The application for bail, being CRM (M) 2066 of 2025, is, thus, dismissed.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
